decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Both translations and the sense are valid, but “different-common-word” overstates the contrast: Indonesian also commonly uses “salah paham,” while “kesalahpahaman” is the derived noun. Malaysian “salah faham” is the corresponding Malay phrase. No false-friend contrast is supported or needed. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
